disciplines.name: Foraging
disciplines.description: Foraging: judge local conditions, practise safe methods and pass reliable results to the next household.

Complete a seasonal cycle with at least 91 days of careful foraging (care ≥70%).
Three years of foraging; key attribute ≥12.
